topic: 多节点TLS轮换与失败回退
title: 项目：两节点真实TLS轮换、失败恢复和连接连续性验收
body:
## 环境与初始材料
非root隔离Linux、Python3、Nginx和OpenSSL。验收生成临时CA/旧证书/新证书/错误域名证书，并启动两个随机高端口回环Nginx，每个仅1worker。所有配置、钥、日志、PID均在题目目录；只允许操作传入的本题节点，禁止连接公网或使用系统80/443。

## 操作任务
实现rollout(nodes,certificate,private_key,ca_file,report_file)，对本题两台Nginx节点执行有回退的TLS轮换。nodes含name/directory/port/pid，目录内已有nginx.conf及tls.crt/tls.key。预检候选证书CA链、lab.test主机名、至少60秒有效期、密钥匹配，并核对每节点原配置语法及磁盘/在线证书一致性；预检失败返回rejected且节点不变。逐节点备份原文件与mode，原子替换key/cert（新key600），原生命令校验后只HUP该节点，轮询真实TLS指纹与HTTP200。全部通过返回committed，nodes列出每节点name/before/after。第二节点失败时恢复已尝试节点的原文件与mode、重新加载并验回原指纹；全部回退成功返回rolled_back及空rollback_errors，回退失败须明确rollback_failed，不能假报成功。轮换前已开始传输的长HTTP响应必须完整结束；Nginx可正常关闭空闲keepalive，客户端重连并不算故障。回退报告增加restored_nodes，列出name及实际恢复fingerprint。报告路径必须位于本工作区、所有节点目录之外，不能与候选证书/私钥/CA相同或为其硬链接，也不能是符号链接或目录；路径非法必须在任何变更前抛ValueError且不写报告。原子写入report_file且与返回值一致，不写私钥内容；清理临时文件。

## 提交产物
task.py；运行产生节点证书文件和report.json审计报告。报告status、nodes、error，回退时包含rollback_errors；证书指纹为DER的SHA256十六进制。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py以真实Nginx/OpenSSL验证：正常两节点轮换及逐节点指纹、错误域名/错配钥预检不变更、第二节点目录不可写时首节点已轮换后的完整回退、私钥600、报告一致性、临时文件回收，以及轮换前两个真实在途流式响应跨轮换与回退后仍完整结束。测试结束停止全部本题进程。所有断言通过退出0；缺工具显示能力待验。仅本地两节点事务与连接连续性实测，不等于公网LB、浏览器全兼容或生产容量验收。

失败示例：只回报rolled_back但没恢复第一节点的证书文件，造成两个入口实际版本不一致；只恢复磁盘、不重载同样不合格。

failure_examples: 第二节点失败后未恢复第一节点的磁盘和在线证书

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,subprocess,socket,time,ssl,hashlib,contextlib,http.client,http.server,threading,os,json,sys,stat
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
def command(args):return subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=5).stdout
def freeport():
    with socket.socket() as s:s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));return s.getsockname()[1]
def certificate(name,hostname,days='1'):
    command(['openssl','req','-new','-newkey','ec','-pkeyopt','ec_paramgen_curve:P-256','-nodes','-keyout',name+'.key','-out',name+'.csr','-subj','/CN='+hostname])
    pathlib.Path(name+'.ext').write_text('subjectAltName=DNS:'+hostname+'\nbasicConstraints=CA:FALSE\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
    command(['openssl','x509','-req','-in',name+'.csr','-CA','ca.crt','-CAkey','ca.key','-CAcreateserial','-out',name+'.crt','-days',days,'-extfile',name+'.ext'])
command(['openssl','req','-x509','-newkey','ec','-pkeyopt','ec_paramgen_curve:P-256','-nodes','-keyout','ca.key','-out','ca.crt','-days','1','-subj','/CN=Ephemeral OpsForge CA'])
for name,host in [('old','lab.test'),('new','lab.test'),('wrong','other.test')]:certificate(name,host)
certificate('expired','lab.test','0')
def digest(path):return hashlib.sha256(ssl.PEM_cert_to_DER_cert(pathlib.Path(path).read_text())).hexdigest()
context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile='ca.crt')
def live(node):
    with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',node['port']),timeout=2) as raw:
        with context.wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname='lab.test') as conn:return hashlib.sha256(conn.getpeercert(binary_form=True)).hexdigest()
@contextlib.contextmanager
def stream_origin():
    release=threading.Event()
    class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        protocol_version='HTTP/1.1'
        def do_GET(self):
            self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Length','9');self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b'begin-');self.wfile.flush()
            release.wait(20)
            try:self.wfile.write(b'end');self.wfile.flush()
            except (BrokenPipeError,ConnectionResetError):pass
        def log_message(self,*args):pass
    server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler)
    worker=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);worker.start()
    try:yield server.server_port,release
    finally:release.set();server.shutdown();server.server_close();worker.join(2);assert not worker.is_alive()
@contextlib.contextmanager
def node(name,stream_port):
    d=ROOT/name;d.mkdir();port=freeport()
    (d/'tls.crt').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('old.crt').read_bytes());(d/'tls.key').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('old.key').read_bytes());(d/'tls.key').chmod(0o600)
    config='daemon off;\nworker_processes 1;\npid {d}/nginx.pid;\nerror_log {d}/error.log;\nevents {{ worker_connections 64; }}\nhttp {{ access_log off;\nclient_body_temp_path {d}/client_body; proxy_temp_path {d}/proxy_temp;\nfastcgi_temp_path {d}/fastcgi_temp; uwsgi_temp_path {d}/uwsgi_temp; scgi_temp_path {d}/scgi_temp;\nserver {{ listen 127.0.0.1:{port} ssl; server_name lab.test;\nssl_certificate {d}/tls.crt; ssl_certificate_key {d}/tls.key;\nkeepalive_timeout 30s; location /stream {{ proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:{stream_port}; proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 30s; }}\nlocation / {{ return 200 "{name}-ready"; }} }} }}\n'.format(d=d,port=port,name=name,stream_port=stream_port)
    (d/'nginx.conf').write_text(config)
    log=open(d/'process.log','wb');process=subprocess.Popen(['nginx','-p',str(d)+'/', '-c',str(d/'nginx.conf')],stdout=log,stderr=log)
    result={'name':name,'directory':str(d),'port':port,'pid':process.pid}
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            assert process.poll() is None,(d/'process.log').read_text()
            try:
                if live(result)==digest('old.crt'):break
            except OSError:pass
            time.sleep(.02)
        else:raise AssertionError('node did not start')
        yield result
    finally:
        d.chmod(0o700)
        if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()
        try:process.wait(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=2)
        log.close()
def assert_delivery(nodes,cert):
    expected=digest(cert+'.crt')
    for n in nodes:
        actual=live(n);assert actual==expected,(n['name'],actual,expected)
        assert (pathlib.Path(n['directory'])/'tls.crt').read_bytes()==pathlib.Path(cert+'.crt').read_bytes()
        assert (pathlib.Path(n['directory'])/'tls.key').read_bytes()==pathlib.Path(cert+'.key').read_bytes()
        assert stat.S_IMODE((pathlib.Path(n['directory'])/'tls.key').stat().st_mode)==0o600
def stream(node):
    c=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',node['port'],context=context,timeout=2)
    # Explicit lab.test SNI with the numeric loopback target.
    raw=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',node['port']),timeout=2);c.sock=context.wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname='lab.test')
    c.request('GET','/stream',headers={'Host':'lab.test'});response=c.getresponse();assert response.status==200 and response.read(6)==b'begin-'
    return c,response
with stream_origin() as (stream_port,release),node('node-a',stream_port) as a,node('node-b',stream_port) as b:
    nodes=[a,b];persistent=[]
    # Report aliases must be rejected before even the bad-certificate path.
    protected=[pathlib.Path('wrong.crt'),pathlib.Path('wrong.key'),pathlib.Path('ca.crt')]
    for n in nodes:protected.extend([pathlib.Path(n['directory'])/'nginx.conf',pathlib.Path(n['directory'])/'tls.crt',pathlib.Path(n['directory'])/'tls.key'])
    snapshot={path:path.read_bytes() for path in protected}
    targets=[*protected,pathlib.Path(a['directory'])/'new-report.json',ROOT,ROOT.parent/'outside-fleet-report.json']
    symlink=ROOT/'report-link';symlink.symlink_to(pathlib.Path(a['directory'])/'nginx.conf')
    hardlink=ROOT/'report-ca-hardlink';os.link('ca.crt',hardlink);targets += [symlink,hardlink]
    try:
        for destination in targets:
            existed=destination.exists();previous=destination.read_bytes() if existed and destination.is_file() else None
            try:task.rollout(nodes,'wrong.crt','wrong.key','ca.crt',destination)
            except ValueError:pass
            else:raise AssertionError(('protected report destination was accepted',str(destination)))
            assert all(path.read_bytes()==content for path,content in snapshot.items()),'path rejection changed protected input/node file'
            if previous is not None:assert destination.read_bytes()==previous
            if not existed:assert not destination.exists()
            assert live(a)==live(b)==digest('old.crt')
    finally:symlink.unlink(missing_ok=True);hardlink.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    try:
        persistent=[stream(n) for n in nodes]
        result=task.rollout(nodes,'new.crt','new.key','ca.crt','report.json')
        assert result['status']=='committed',result
        assert sorted(x['name'] for x in result['nodes'])==['node-a','node-b']
        assert all(x['before']==digest('old.crt') and x['after']==digest('new.crt') for x in result['nodes'])
        assert result==json.loads(pathlib.Path('report.json').read_text())
        assert_delivery(nodes,'new')
        assert all(not response.isclosed() for c,response in persistent)
        for cert,key in [('wrong.crt','wrong.key'),('old.crt','new.key'),('expired.crt','expired.key')]:
            result=task.rollout(nodes,cert,key,'ca.crt','report.json')
            assert result['status']=='rejected' and result['nodes']==[],result
            assert_delivery(nodes,'new')
        result=task.rollout(nodes,'old.crt','old.key','wrong.crt','report.json')
        assert result['status']=='rejected',result
        assert_delivery(nodes,'new')
        # A valid on-disk pair that differs from the loaded certificate is rejected.
        bd=pathlib.Path(b['directory'])
        try:
            (bd/'tls.crt').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('old.crt').read_bytes())
            (bd/'tls.key').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('old.key').read_bytes())
            result=task.rollout(nodes,'old.crt','old.key','ca.crt','report.json')
            assert result['status']=='rejected' and result['nodes']==[],result
            assert live(a)==live(b)==digest('new.crt')
            assert (bd/'tls.crt').read_bytes()==pathlib.Path('old.crt').read_bytes()
        finally:
            (bd/'tls.crt').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('new.crt').read_bytes())
            (bd/'tls.key').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('new.key').read_bytes())
        directory=pathlib.Path(b['directory']);directory.chmod(0o555)
        try:result=task.rollout(nodes,'old.crt','old.key','ca.crt','report.json')
        finally:directory.chmod(0o700)
        assert result['status']=='rolled_back' and result['rollback_errors']==[],result
        assert sorted(x['name'] for x in result['restored_nodes'])==['node-a','node-b']
        assert all(x['fingerprint']==digest('new.crt') for x in result['restored_nodes'])
        assert_delivery(nodes,'new')
        release.set()
        for c,response in persistent:assert response.read()==b'end','in-flight response was interrupted'
        assert result==json.loads(pathlib.Path('report.json').read_text())
        assert 'PRIVATE KEY' not in pathlib.Path('report.json').read_text()
        assert not list(ROOT.rglob('.rollout-*'))
    finally:
        release.set()
        for c,response in persistent:c.close()

review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
